loop.prompt: Locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom, photorealistic. The handmade cotton toy sits at the small marble café table under the Bologna arcade and reads its newspaper: it slowly turns a page, lifts the tiny espresso cup, takes a sip and sets it back on the saucer, breaks a small piece off the golden brioche and nibbles it, then returns to reading, content. A gentle evening breeze stirs the corner of the newspaper and its green felt collar; the hanging iron lanterns sway very slightly; a faint wisp of steam rises from the cup; soft shimmer of warm light on the stone floor. The toy, the table, the chair and the arcade stay exactly as in the image; calm, slow, natural motion; no new objects, no people, no text; it ends in the same pose it starts in.
